office_does: A district court judge hears misdemeanors, gross misdemeanors, city-ordinance violations, traffic infractions and preliminary hearings in Chelan County.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Judge Allen F. Blackmon, appointed in 2022 and elected in 2024 over Jay Eyestone, is the only candidate for a four-year term.

candidates.summary: Chelan County District Court judge since his 2022 appointment, re-elected in 2024; a county deputy prosecutor from 1996 to 2022. The only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Appointed in 2022 to replace Judge Kyle Mott [S3][S4]
Won the 2024 election with 60.27% over Jay Eyestone [S7]
Chelan County deputy prosecutor from 1996 to 2022, mostly handling juvenile cases [S1][S3]
